title: Petra and the Deadline
author: Tamsin Underhill
blurb: Kestrel Vasquez, a whistle-blower living under four names, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must burn the network that did the training before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
